notes: PRODIGY.MC is a fully modular mainframe: essentially all signal I/O (mic/line, AES3, MADI, Dante/RAVENNA/SoundGrid audio network, USB-network) is provided by field-installable cards, not the base chassis, so there is no single fixed "as shipped" signal port list — configurations vary per order. The ports listed above are the FIXED chassis connectors present on every unit regardless of card configuration (power, management network, legacy-control USB, headphone monitors, word clock). Card-slot connector types (not itemized as individual ports here because channel count/connector depends entirely on which module is ordered): 1x "A" slot for audio-network/MADI/USB modules (1x SFP cage + 2x RJ45, up to 128 ch, Dante/RAVENNA/SoundGrid); 2x "B" slots for single-port MADI modules (selectable SFP cage, SC multi/single-mode optical, or 75 ohm coaxial BNC, up to 64 ch each); 8x "C" slots for mic/line, AD/DA, or AES3 converter modules, each terminating in a DSUB-25 (AES59/"Tascam" pinout) socket carrying 8 balanced analog or 4-port AES3 channels. Total capacity with full population is 320 inputs / 324 outputs. GPIO is a single DSUB-9 female socket (2x GPI, 2x GPO) — mapped to the closest allowed connector id (rs232) since DSUB-9 isn't in the provided connector list; it is a control I/O, not a serial data port, so no grade applies. Word clock BNCs and headphone jacks are correctly gradeless (analog/clock signals, not bandwidth-graded connector types). Power: two independent, phase-redundant PSUs, each with its own IEC C13 inlet, 84-264V AC 47-63Hz, individually switched, each fused 250V/4A slow-blow x2. Rack size 2U (89mm H x 483mm W x 254mm D), approx. 10 kg. Sourced directly from DirectOut's official PRODIGY.MC User's Manual v2.5 (authoritative primary source); cross-checked against directout.eu/product/prodigy-mc/ and retailer listings (Sweetwater, Synthax UK, Dale Pro Audio) which corroborate slot/channel counts.
